answer.notes: Community Grants applications are rolling; the October 5, 2026 deadline applies to the separate competitive grant round. An economically disadvantaged community has median household income below 80% of area median income. The application is limited to 4–5 pages excluding maps and photos. Its schedule and budget are form sections, not separate required attachments; maps and photos are optional. A landowner letter confirming willingness to host is required if the applicant does not own the site. A participating Tribe's leadership letter is requested with the final application. After Board approval, the grant agreement and required pre-start documents must be completed. Site visits are scheduled as appropriate. Possible audits are stated, but commissioning an independent audit and attending training are not expressly required.
